description.zh: 由 Kiyori 宿主安全调用 OpenAI Responses hosted web_search 的独立搜索插件，可供任意主聊天模型使用。
description.en: A standalone search plugin that securely invokes OpenAI Responses hosted web_search through the Kiyori host for use with any primary chat model.

description.zh: 配置来源。PACKAGE_ENV 使用本插件环境；MODEL_CONFIG 绑定固定模型配置 ID。
description.en: Configuration source. PACKAGE_ENV uses this plugin environment; MODEL_CONFIG binds a fixed model config ID.

description.zh: 官方 Responses 合同或经过显式兼容探测的严格中转合同。
description.en: Official Responses contract or strict relay contract verified by an explicit compatibility probe.

description.zh: MODEL_CONFIG 模式绑定的固定模型配置 ID，不跟随当前聊天配置。
description.en: Fixed model config ID used by MODEL_CONFIG mode. It never follows the active chat configuration.

description.zh: 完整 Responses HTTPS 地址，例如官方 https://api.openai.com/v1/responses。PACKAGE_ENV 模式必填。
description.en: Complete HTTPS Responses endpoint, such as the official https://api.openai.com/v1/responses. Required for PACKAGE_ENV.

description.zh: 专用于联网搜索的精确模型名。官方合同默认 gpt-5.6-luna。
description.en: Exact model name dedicated to web search. The official contract defaults to gpt-5.6-luna.

description.zh: 仅由 Kiyori 宿主读取的搜索 API Key。PACKAGE_ENV 模式必填，插件 JavaScript 无法读取。
description.en: Search API key read only by the Kiyori host. Required for PACKAGE_ENV and inaccessible to plugin JavaScript.

description.zh: PACKAGE_ENV 模式认证 Header 名。
description.en: Authentication header name for PACKAGE_ENV mode.

description.zh: PACKAGE_ENV 模式认证前缀，默认 Bearer；留空表示直接发送 Key。
description.en: Authentication scheme for PACKAGE_ENV mode. Defaults to Bearer; leave empty to send the key directly.

description.zh: PACKAGE_ENV 模式附加 Header JSON 对象。认证和 hop-by-hop Header 会被拒绝；Codex-compatible 中转可按服务商要求显式配置 x-openai-actor-authorization。
description.en: Additional header JSON object for PACKAGE_ENV mode. Authentication and hop-by-hop headers are rejected; Codex-compatible relays may explicitly configure x-openai-actor-authorization when required by the provider.

description.zh: 搜索模型思考强度：omit、none、low、medium、high、xhigh 或 max。
description.en: Search model reasoning effort: omit, none, low, medium, high, xhigh, or max.

description.zh: 可选最大输出 token 数，留空表示不显式发送。
description.en: Optional maximum output token count. Leave empty to omit the field.

description.zh: Web Search 返回 token 预算。
description.en: Web Search return token budget.

description.zh: 追加到宿主固定安全指令后的搜索说明，最多 4000 字符。
description.en: Search instructions appended after the host's fixed safety instruction, up to 4000 characters.

description.zh: true 使用实时 live 搜索；false 使用 indexed 搜索。
description.en: true uses live web access; false uses indexed search.

description.zh: 默认搜索上下文大小。
description.en: Default search context size.

description.zh: 默认允许域名 JSON 字符串数组。工具调用只能进一步收窄。
description.en: Default allowed-domain JSON string array. Tool calls may only narrow it.

description.zh: 默认屏蔽域名 JSON 字符串数组。
description.en: Default blocked-domain JSON string array.

description.zh: 可选 approximate location JSON，仅在工具调用明确启用时使用。
description.en: Optional approximate-location JSON, used only when the tool call explicitly enables it.

description.zh: 单次请求超时秒数，范围 1 到 300。
description.en: Per-request timeout in seconds, from 1 to 300.

description.zh: 插件最大并发请求数，范围 1 到 8。
description.en: Maximum concurrent plugin requests, from 1 to 8.

description.zh: 插件每分钟请求上限。0 表示不设置插件级 RPM 上限。
description.en: Plugin request limit per minute. 0 means no plugin-level RPM limit.
